data.one_liner: A very strict set of lints for Dart and Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Enables almost all available linter rules by default, deliberately rejecting only a few. Provides separate rule sets optimized for applications and reusable packages.
use_when: You want strict code style and error checking without maintaining a large custom linter configuration
You want a robust baseline for either runnable apps or reusable packages
avoid_when: You prefer default or loose linter configurations
You do not want to deal with strict rules flagged by newer Dart versions
strengths: Saves time by enabling all beneficial linter rules by default
Distinguishes between rules suitable for runnable apps versus reusable packages
Regularly updated with new Dart lints
weaknesses: Can introduce a high volume of linter warnings on existing projects when first integrated
data.setup_notes: Add the package under dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and include the appropriate configuration file in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official, less aggressive set of recommended lints maintained by the Flutter team.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the official Dart core and recommended lints instead of an exhaustive set.
